newsitem.title: USA: World Airways Feb block hours 3,251.
newsitem.headline: World Airways Feb block hours 3,251.

text.p: World Airways Inc said block hours flown for continuing operations totaled 3,251 for February, compared to 2,914 in February 1996, an increase of about 12 percent.
The company said average daily utilization was 8.9 block hours per day versus 9.7 block hours per day for the same period in 1996.
The company said average aircraft units were 13.0 compared with 10.4 for the same period in 1996.
For the year to date ended February 28, block hours for continuing operations totaled 7,104 compared with 6,045 for the same period in 1996, an increase of about 18 percent, the company said.
Average daily utilization was 9.3 block hours per day versus 9.8 block hours per day for the same period in 1996, the company said.
Average aircraft units were 13.0 compared with 10.3 for the same 1996 period, the company said.
